QUOTE: Tier-3 and tier-4 values survive every stated tier. A declaration cannot remove a macro that the Doxyfile defines. Heuristics (tier 5) are the only layer a stated value displaces.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the combination formula, where tiers 3 and 4 appear as ∪ tier3 ∪ tier4. It never says the two combine identically, that the tier 3/4 distinction is inert, or that fact-versus-guess is the load-bearing line.
